hook.name: StarHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for bonding-curve token launches registered via a factory contract. On each swap, it deducts a configurable fee (default 1%, max 3%) from the quote-token leg and credits it to the token's creator. Buys within a configurable block window after launch incur a higher anti-snipe tax (default 12%). Fees accumulate in the hook and are claimable by token creators.
